name: haembina-branch-analysis
description: The npm tooling around the Gradle build of Haembina Branch Analysis: linters and test runners.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:sh && npm run lint:es && npm run lint:gradle && npm run lint:java
scripts.lint:sh: shellcheck scripts/integration-test.sh scripts/test-ci.sh docker/branch-analysis-entrypoint.sh docker/test-branch-analysis-entrypoint.sh sonarqube-webapp-addons/setup.sh
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run lint:md
